reason: I do not own the room. I run my league in whoever's hall will have us that week, on whoever's wifi, so a screen on the wall and a per-venue price is not really sold to me. And I have had a rep on the phone about software every other week for years; I am not going to put my Tuesday night on an app I have never seen hold up.
objection: What happens when the internet drops in the middle of a tournament? If the bracket is on a phone and the signal goes, I am standing in front of forty people with nothing, and the whole point was to stop the arguing.
would_change_my_mind: Show me it keeps running with no signal at all - scores still go in on the phone and sync up later - and send someone to sit with me and my two helpers for the first night so none of us has to learn it from a manual.
